# NPB live regression fixtures

Public Sportsnavi captures from 2026-09-28:

- https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/game/2021039468/score
- https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/game/2021039468/text
- https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/game/2021039469/score
- https://baseball.yahoo.co.jp/npb/game/2021039469/text

HTML is limited to source title/canonical identity, live state/player/pitch elements, and numbered inning events. JSON contains the existing parser's corresponding game data. Captures exercise an active at-bat, two occupied bases, a completed half-inning, reverse-ordered source events, and NPB display-name aliases. These snapshots are test inputs, not current live scores.
